# One real ECDSA certificate chain, frozen: the four certificates
# letsencrypt.org served on 2026-08-02 -- leaf (P-256), YE2 (P-384),
# Root YE (P-384), and ISRG Root X2 cross-signed by ISRG Root X1 --
# plus ISRG Root X1 itself as the host's own trust store holds it,
# from /etc/ssl/cert.pem rather than from the peer, since trusting
# the chain's own last certificate would be circular.
#
# This is the ECDSA twin of x509_real_chain.txt, and it is also the
# cross-algorithm case the web actually serves: the store's anchor is
# RSA, the cross-sign under it is sha256WithRSA over an EC subject,
# and everything below is ECDSA over P-384 and P-256. One chain walks
# every signature pairing this stack implements.
leaf 
ye2 
rootye 
x2cross 
isrgx1
